## English

This directory contains the ISO/OSI protocol family (CLNP, TP4, ...).

`config.mk` records 37 source file(s) here: `clnp_debug.c`, `clnp_er.c`, `clnp_frag.c`, `clnp_input.c`, `clnp_options.c`, `clnp_output.c`, `clnp_raw.c`, `clnp_subr.c`, `clnp_timer.c`, `cltp_usrreq.c`, `esis.c`, `idrp_usrreq.c`, ....

Subdirectories: `xebec/`.

These `config.mk` lists are reference metadata from the 4.5BSD tree; the BSD45 build scripts (`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`) select the files that are actually compiled.
